mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(account.current_balance) FROM connected_account account INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS base_asset, goal.target_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(SUM(history.amount) / 3) FROM transaction_history history INNER JOIN connected_account account ON account.account_id = history.account_id INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND history.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAW' AND (history.category IS NULL OR history.category != 'ASSET') AND history.transaction_datetime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) ), 0) AS monthly_spending_average, profile.soldier_type, profile.enlistment_date, profile.discharge_date FROM soldier_profile profile INNER JOIN goal ON goal.user_id = profile.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE profile.user_id = #{userId}
